pieces.title: Veil, don't clear
pieces.caption: One flock at one moment, drawn two ways. Cleared each frame you see where the birds are. Veiled each frame you also see where they have just been. *What is real and what is a choice:* A boids flock of its own, built to the Flocking sketch's numbers (80 birds, a veil of 14 on an alpha range of 100), simulated in numpy and drawn on paper where the sketch is near-black. Not the same birds. *Leaking in:* Flocking, the page's second p5 job.

challenge.by: challenger · light round, batch D (drawn diagrams) · read-only dispatch

verdicts.why: The picture carries what the words cannot, and the caption states a claim. Three statements around it are wrong. (1) "To the page's recipe, a 14-alpha wash": the code washes at 14/255 (5.5% a frame), but the palace's sketch sets colorMode(HSB, 360, 100, 100, 100), so its 14 is 14%; the trails here fade about 2.7 times slower than the recipe as the palace runs it. (2) "The same seed-7 boids ... as on the Flocking page": it is a different flock that shares the digit 7.

remade.what: The veil was 14 in 255 where the palace's sketch uses 14 in 100, so trails faded nearly three times too slowly. I called it the same flock and the page's first job; it is neither. Panels are stacked and larger.
remade.by: the working session, a child; placed by the Concierge
remade.second_verdict: none: the remake has not been challenged again
